# f5xc_user (Resource)

Represents user for a given tenant

To get more information about f5xc_user, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/user)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: User - Full

resource "f5xc_user" "example" {
  email      = "example-user@example.com"
  first_name = "Example"
  last_name  = "User"
  namespace  = "system"
  type       = ["USER"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) email user's email
- `first_name` (String) first name User's first name
- `last_name` (String) last name User's last name

### Optional

- `group_names` (List of String) Groups Group list must be associated to this user.
- `idm_type` (List of String) IDM Type Type of the Identity management required for the user. if SSO is not enabled, set this to VOLTERRA_MANAGED VOLTERRA_MANGED user is a local user fully managed by Volterra's User Access Management.<br>**Allowed Values (choose one):** `['SSO', 'UNDEFINED', 'VOLTERRA_MANAGED']`<br>**Default:** `SSO`
- `name` (String) Username This is an optional field meant to be used as username. Inside Volterra's UAM, email is already treated as user's username and as best practice, recommendation is to keep this same as email field. if not specified, this field will be set same as email field.
- `namespace` (String) namespace All users of a tenant must be created in tenant's system namespace.<br>**Default:** `system`<br>**Allowed Values (choose one):** `['system']`
- `namespace_roles` (Attributes Set) Namespace roles List of directly attached roles that the user has for each namespace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--namespace_roles))
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `type` (List of String) User type Type of the user account (USER, SERVICE)<br>**Allowed Values (choose one):** `['DEBUG', 'SERVICE', 'USER']`<br>**Default:** `USER`

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an `import` block to import this resource by ID.

> **Note:** Replace placeholder values (for example, `<namespace>`, `<name>`) with actual values.

#### Command-Line Import

Use the following `command` to import this resource from the command line:

```shell
terraform import f5xc_user.example <namespace>/<email>
```

#### HCL Import Block

Use the following `hcl` block to import this resource during `plan` or `apply`:

```hcl
import {
	id = "<namespace>/<email>"
	to = f5xc_user.example
}
```
